name: Goa Sunkissed Shores & Beach Serenity
short_desc: Immerse yourself in golden sands, Portuguese architecture, vibrant beach shacks, spice plantations, and romantic Mandovi river sunset cruises.
highlights_formatted:
• Private Mandovi River Sunset Luxury Cruise
• Old Goa UNESCO Heritage Cathedrals & Fontainhas Latin Quarter
• Excursion to Dudhsagar Waterfalls & Spice Plantation
• Calangute, Baga & Anjuna Beachside Leisure & Water Sports
• Curated Goan Seafood & Coastal Gourmet Dining
inclusions_formatted:
• Luxury Beachfront Resort Accommodations
• Daily Gourmet Breakfast & Chef Special Dinners
• Private AC Vehicle Transfers & Guided Sightseeing
• Complimentary Sunset Cruise Passes & Sightseeing Tickets

schedule_summary: Day 1: Arrival in Goa & Sunset Beachfront Leisure | Day 2: North Goa Coastal Circuit & Thrilling Water Sports | Day 3: South Goa Portuguese Heritage & Mandovi Sunset Cruise | Day 4: Dudhsagar Waterfalls & Organic Spice Plantation Luncheon | Day 5: Morning Seaside Wellness & Departure
schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Arrival in Goa & Sunset Beachfront Leisure]
Arrive at Goa Airport / MOPA. Experience a VIP private transfer to your luxury beachfront resort. Spend your afternoon relaxing by the pool or taking a barefoot sunset stroll along the golden sands.

[Day 2 - North Goa Coastal Circuit & Thrilling Water Sports]
Explore historic Fort Aguada overlooking the Arabian Sea, followed by the vibrant shores of Calangute, Baga, and Anjuna. Enjoy parasailing, jet skiing, and lunch at an iconic beach club.

[Day 3 - South Goa Portuguese Heritage & Mandovi Sunset Cruise]
Discover the Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, and the charming pastel lanes of Fontainhas in Panjim. In the evening, embark on a private luxury sunset cruise on the Mandovi River with live Goan folk music.

[Day 4 - Dudhsagar Waterfalls & Organic Spice Plantation Luncheon]
Take a 4x4 jungle jeep safari to the cascading Dudhsagar Waterfalls nestled in the Western Ghats. Tour a heritage spice plantation with an aromatic buffet lunch served on banana leaves.

[Day 5 - Morning Seaside Wellness & Departure]
Enjoy morning seaside yoga and a lavish breakfast spread. Explore local handicraft markets before a seamless private transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

name: Bali Tropical Temples & Island Romance
short_desc: Experience the magic of Bali with lush Ubud rice terraces, clifftop Uluwatu sunsets, sacred temples, Nusa Penida island speedboat tours, and private pool villas.
highlights_formatted:
• Tegallalang Emerald Rice Terraces & Iconic Jungle Swing
• Clifftop Uluwatu Temple & Sunset Fire Kecak Dance
• Full-Day Nusa Penida Speedboat Tour (Kelingking & Angel Billabong)
• Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest & Traditional Artisan Villages
• Jimbaran Bay Candlelit Seafood Beachside Dinner
inclusions_formatted:
• Private Pool Villa & 5-Star Luxury Resort Stay
• Daily Floating Breakfasts & Gourmet Dining
• Speedboat Tickets to Nusa Penida with Local Island Guide
• All Entry Permits, Monument Passes & Cultural Performances
• Private Chauffeur-Driven Air-Conditioned Vehicle Throughout
schedule_summary: Day 1: Arrival in Denpasar & Ubud Rainforest Check-In | Day 2: Ubud Cultural Circuit, Rice Terraces & Jungle Swing | Day 3: Kintamani Volcano Panorama & Sacred Water Temples | Day 4: Exhilarating Nusa Penida Island Speedboat Day Tour | Day 5: Seminyak Coastal Vibes, Uluwatu Clifftop & Kecak Dance | Day 6: Balinese Spa Rejuvenation & Departure Transfer
schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Arrival in Denpasar & Ubud Rainforest Check-In]
Traditional Balinese floral garland welcome at Ngurah Rai Airport. Transfer to your luxury private pool villa in Ubud. Relax with complimentary herbal tea and scenic valley views.

[Day 2 - Ubud Cultural Circuit, Rice Terraces & Jungle Swing]
Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest, swing high above the Tegallalang Rice Terraces, and stop by Tegenungan Waterfall. Sample famous Luwak coffee at a traditional plantation.

[Day 3 - Kintamani Volcano Panorama & Sacred Water Temples]
Witness panoramic views of active Mount Batur volcano and Lake Batur. Experience a purification blessing ritual at the holy spring water temple of Tirta Empul.

[Day 4 - Exhilarating Nusa Penida Island Speedboat Day Tour]
Sail across the Badung Strait to Nusa Penida. Marvel at the T-Rex shaped Kelingking Clifftop, snorkel in Crystal Bay, and photograph Broken Beach and Angel’s Billabong.

[Day 5 - Seminyak Coastal Vibes, Uluwatu Clifftop & Kecak Dance]
Transfer to South Bali. Explore trendy Seminyak, visit the clifftop Uluwatu Temple perched 70 meters above crashing waves, and watch the mesmerizing sunset Kecak dance followed by Jimbaran seafood dinner.

[Day 6 - Balinese Spa Rejuvenation & Departure Transfer]
Indulge in a signature 90-minute Balinese massage session. Visit artisan souvenir markets for authentic woodcarvings and batik before your VIP airport departure.

name: Kashmir Valley of Serenity & Alpine Meadows
short_desc: Drift on Dal Lake in heritage cedar houseboats, ride the world-highest Gulmarg Gondola over snow peaks, and stroll through Pahalgam pine valleys.
highlights_formatted:
• Heritage Carved Cedar Luxury Houseboat Stay on Dal Lake
• Sunset Shikara Ride & Floating Flower / Spice Market
• Gulmarg Gondola Cable Car Ride to Apharwat Peak (Phase 1 & 2)
• Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Baisaran Pine Meadows
• Mughal Gardens (Shalimar, Nishat Bagh & Chashme Shahi)
inclusions_formatted:
• Houseboat & Premium Alpine Resort Accommodations
• Daily Traditional Kashmiri Wazwan & Multi-Cuisine Meals
• Private Shikara Rides & Gondola Phase 1 & 2 Priority Passes
• Dedicated Private Heating-Equipped 4x4 / Luxury Vehicle
• Experienced Local Kashmir Concierge & Heritage Guide
schedule_summary: Day 1: Srinagar Arrival, Houseboat Check-In & Sunset Shikara | Day 2: Gulmarg Meadow of Flowers & Gondola Snow Adventure | Day 3: Saffron Fields of Pampore & Journey to Pahalgam | Day 4: Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Baisaran Trek | Day 5: Return to Srinagar & Historic Mughal Gardens Tour | Day 6: Lal Chowk Souvenirs, Pashmina Shopping & Departure
schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Srinagar Arrival, Houseboat Check-In & Sunset Shikara]
Warm welcome at Srinagar Airport with traditional Kahwa tea. Check in to an intricately hand-carved luxury houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy a peaceful sunset Shikara ride across the lotus gardens.

[Day 2 - Gulmarg Meadow of Flowers & Gondola Snow Adventure]
Drive through apple orchards to Gulmarg. Board the famous Gulmarg Gondola rising up to Apharwat Peak for breathtaking views of Nanga Parbat. Enjoy skiing, sledding, or alpine walks.

[Day 3 - Saffron Fields of Pampore & Journey to Pahalgam]
Scenic drive to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds) along the Lidder River. Stop by the world-famous saffron fields of Pampore and the 9th-century Avantipur temple ruins.

[Day 4 - Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Baisaran Trek]
Explore Betaab Valley surrounded by snow peaks and pine forests. Take a horseback excursion through Baisaran (Mini Switzerland) and visit the tranquil meadows of Aru Valley.

[Day 5 - Return to Srinagar & Historic Mughal Gardens Tour]
Return to Srinagar. Tour the terraced Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh (Garden of Bliss), Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi spring. Visit Shankaracharya Temple overlooking the valley.

[Day 6 - Lal Chowk Souvenirs, Pashmina Shopping & Departure]
Shop for authentic Kashmiri Pashmina shawls, saffron, walnut woodcrafts, and dry fruits. Private transfer to Srinagar Airport for your departure flight with cherished memories.

short_desc: Relive the golden era of Rajput royalty with Lake Pichola private boat cruises, sprawling marble palaces, vintage car collections, and folk dance galas.
highlights_formatted:
• Private Sunset Boat Cruise on Lake Pichola past Jag Mandir
• Grand City Palace Complex & Royal Crystal Gallery Tour
• Dharohar Folk Dance & Puppet Show at Bagore Ki Haveli
• Day Excursion to the Great Wall of India at Kumbhalgarh Fort
• Saheliyon Ki Bari Ornamental Gardens & Jagdish Temple
inclusions_formatted:

schedule_summary: Day 1: Royal Welcome in the City of Lakes & Sunset Boat Cruise | Day 2: City Palace Grandeur, Crystal Gallery & Cultural Gala | Day 3: Excursion to Kumbhalgarh Fort & Ranakpur Marble Temples | Day 4: Vintage Car Collection, Miniature Art & Departure
schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Royal Welcome in the City of Lakes & Sunset Boat Cruise]
Arrive in Udaipur with a traditional royal dhol and tikka welcome at your luxury palace resort. In the late afternoon, enjoy an exclusive private boat cruise on Lake Pichola with sunset views over Lake Palace.

[Day 2 - City Palace Grandeur, Crystal Gallery & Cultural Gala]
Explore the sprawling City Palace complex, towering above Lake Pichola with ornate marble balconies and mirror work. Visit Jagdish Temple, Saheliyon-ki-Bari, and attend the evening Bagore Ki Haveli folk dance show.

[Day 3 - Excursion to Kumbhalgarh Fort & Ranakpur Marble Temples]
Take a scenic journey through the Aravalli hills to the UNESCO World Heritage Kumbhalgarh Fort, famous for the world’s second-longest continuous wall. Stop at Ranakpur to admire 1,444 uniquely carved marble pillars.

[Day 4 - Vintage Car Collection, Miniature Art & Departure]
Visit the Maharana’s Vintage & Classic Car Collection. Experience an authentic Rajasthani miniature painting workshop and shopping in Hathi Pol market before your airport drop.

Disembark after breakfast. Visit Fort Kochi to see the historic Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, and Mattancherry Dutch Palace before your flight departure from Cochin.

name: Manali & Shimla Himalayan Snow & Pine Escapade
short_desc: Escape to snow-clad Himalayan peaks, cross through the engineering marvel of Atal Tunnel, paraglide in Solang Valley, and unwind in luxury wooden chalets.
highlights_formatted:
• Atal Tunnel Crossing & Sissu Lahaul Valley Snow Excursion
• Solang Valley Paragliding, Zorbing & Cable Car Adventures
• Historic Shimla Mall Road, The Ridge & Christ Church Heritage
• Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali Cafes
• Kufri Snow Viewpoint & Scenic Apple Orchard Trails
inclusions_formatted:
• Luxury Wooden Chalet & 5-Star Mountain Resort Accommodations
• Daily Hearty Himalayan Breakfasts & Candlelit Dinners
• Private All-Weather AC Vehicle with Experienced Hill Driver
• Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Special Entry Permits
• 24/7 Dedicated Himachal Travel Desk & Concierge Support
schedule_summary: Day 1: Chandigarh / Delhi to Shimla Scenic Mountain Drive | Day 2: Shimla Heritage Circuit & Kufri Snow Viewpoint | Day 3: Scenic River Drive to Manali via Kullu Valley | Day 4: Manali Local Wonders, Ancient Temples & Hot Springs | Day 5: Solang Valley Thrills & Atal Tunnel Snow Expedition | Day 6: Morning Pine Forest Stroll & Return Departure
schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Chandigarh / Delhi to Shimla Scenic Mountain Drive]
Pick-up from Chandigarh or Delhi. Enjoy a picturesque drive through the Shivalik foothills to colonial Shimla. Check in to your luxury resort and take an evening stroll along Mall Road and The Ridge.

[Day 2 - Shimla Heritage Circuit & Kufri Snow Viewpoint]
Visit Kufri for breathtaking Himalayan panoramic views and horse rides through pine trails. Tour the historic Viceregal Lodge and visit Jakhoo Temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman.

[Day 3 - Scenic River Drive to Manali via Kullu Valley]
Travel alongside the sparkling Beas River from Shimla to Manali. Stop at Kullu for world-famous Pashmina shawl weaving and optional white-water river rafting before reaching Manali.

[Day 4 - Manali Local Wonders, Ancient Temples & Hot Springs]
Discover the 500-year-old wooden Hadimba Devi Temple set inside cedar forests. Visit Manu Temple, soak in the natural sulphur hot springs of Vashisht, and explore bohemian Old Manali cafes.

[Day 5 - Solang Valley Thrills & Atal Tunnel Snow Expedition]
Head to Solang Valley for paragliding and quad biking. Drive through the historic Atal Tunnel (world’s longest highway tunnel above 10,000 ft) into the dramatic snow landscapes of Sissu in Lahaul Valley.

[Day 6 - Morning Pine Forest Stroll & Return Departure]
Enjoy morning views of snow-dusted peaks over breakfast. Check out and embark on your return drive to Chandigarh Airport/Railway Station for your onward journey.

schedule_full_details:
[Day 1 - Arrival in Phuket & Andaman Sunset Beachfront Check-In]
Warm welcome at Phuket International Airport and private transfer to your luxury beachfront resort. Savor a chilled tropical cocktail while watching the Andaman sunset over the ocean.

[Day 2 - Phi Phi Islands, Maya Bay & Coral Snorkeling Speedboat Tour]
Board a premium speedboat to Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Ley. Swim in the emerald waters of Maya Bay, photograph Viking Cave, and snorkel among colorful marine life at Monkey Beach.

[Day 3 - James Bond Island & Phang Nga Bay Mangrove Canoeing]
Cruise to mystical Phang Nga Bay. Paddle canoes through limestone cave lagoons (Hong Island) and visit the world-renowned James Bond Island (Koh Tapu).

[Day 4 - Scenic Coastal Drive to Krabi & Ao Nang Beach Leisure]
Private coastal transfer from Phuket to Krabi past limestone karsts. Check in to your luxury cliffside resort in Ao Nang. Relax with an authentic 60-minute traditional Thai massage.

[Day 5 - Krabi Iconic 4-Islands Speedboat Expedition]
Explore Koh Poda, Chicken Island, and Tup Island (witness the sandbar phenomenon at low tide). Visit Phra Nang Cave Beach renowned for its rock climbing cliffs and sacred shrine.

[Day 6 - Morning Beach Walk, Souvenir Shopping & Departure]
Enjoy your final morning beach walk and tropical breakfast. Private transfer to Krabi or Phuket Airport for your return flight with unforgettable memories.
